name: unsafe fn extend_one_unchecked (& mut self , item : A) where Self : Sized ,
rule: Callers that have reserved enough space with `extend_reserve` may safely call `extend_one_unchecked` to add an item within that reserved capacity.
api: trait Extend < A > : { unsafe fn extend_one_unchecked (& mut self , item : A) where Self : Sized , }
